theory: Prompts are versioned instruction artifacts whose variables must be complete and whose identities cover the experiment actually seeing them. User slash templates are separately treated as expanded user input. A recorded instruction condition therefore remains meaningful without promoting local prose to system policy.
instead_of: A bag of string constants could deliver immediate text, but would not model missing-variable refusal, packaged resources, or separate staged, batch, and user-input identities.

absorption.rationale: New templates and commands fit, but comparing alternate instruction revisions within one process requires revisiting cached resources and import-time rendered/hash constants. The present model binds an immutable installed set to process lifetime.

world_mapping.rationale: Templates, strict rendering, frozen signatures, and experiment-specific hashes identify the instructions received; user expansion records actual supplied text.

abstraction.rationale: Jinja/importlib.resources handle mechanics while semantic functions assemble proof/review inputs. User positional substitution has its own grammar because ordinary LaTeX dollars must survive.

justification.rationale: Missing variables are justified by lost theorem identity; independent review excludes the formalizer's explanation, and tests check separate batch/staged hashes.

honest_limits.rationale: The loader states its immutable-installed-template assumption; user templates explain why they are outside experiment hashes and state size/symlink limits.

rehearsals.requirement: Add a project slash template with two positional arguments.
rehearsals.why: Positional placeholders, missing-argument refusal, and recording expanded prose already exist.
Extend renderer/template together; StrictUndefined makes a missing supplying call fail visibly.

rehearsals.requirement: A/B test two installed instruction revisions in one long-lived process.
rehearsals.why: Caching, no-auto-reload resources, and imported rendered/hash constants bind one set per process; per-run prompt bundles need a new ownership boundary.
